reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_: PL/0016/26 - Listed Building Consent Application Withdrawn
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Details for the following are to be provided to, and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of
the work commences:</p><p class="MsoNormal">&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">a)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Clay and
slate tiles, including bat access tiles to be fitted to west facing slopes.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">b)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Bricks<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">c)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Paint
to be used (to be breathable).<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">d)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Non-traditional
repairs to timber work.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">e)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;How
thermal upgrade works would avoid cold spots and condensation.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">f)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Reinstatement
of fireplace surrounds and hearths, the reinstatement of which is to be
completed within 1 year of the date of this approval.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">The works shall be completed in accordance with the approved
details and shall thereafter be retained.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="margin-left:42.55pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-42.55pt;tab-stops:288.0pt;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">



















</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON:
To help protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed
building.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:42.55pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:
-42.55pt;tab-stops:42.55pt 288.0pt;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none"><b>Recording</b></p><p class="MsoNormal">A full photographic and textual recording report of the
entirety of the Listed Building shall be undertaken to a Level 2 standard as
indicated in the Historic England guidance document <i>Understanding
Historic Buildings: A Guide to Good Recording Practice</i> (Historic
England, May 2016) and:<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">&nbsp;a)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;then
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, before
any works are undertaken.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal">b)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;following
completion of all works hereby approved, and using evidence gained during all
stages of the implementation of this consent, shall be submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">c)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;The
final copy approved under parts (2a) and (2b) is to be submitted to the Greater
London Historic Environment Record and Harrow Archives, with copy of receipt
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, within 2
weeks of the date of their approval.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">REASON: To help protect the special architectural or
historic interest of the listed building.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><b>Written scheme of historic building investigation
(WSI)&nbsp; <o:p></o:p></b></p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">No demolition shall take place until a written
scheme of historic building investigation (WSI) has been submitted to and
approved by the local planning authority in writing. For buildings that are
included within the WSI, no demolition or development shall take place other
than in accordance with the agreed WSI, which shall include the statement of
significance and research objectives, and: <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">A. &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; The programme and methodology of
historic building investigation and recording and the nomination of a competent
person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">B.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; The programme for post-investigation
assessment and subsequent analysis, publication &amp; dissemination and
deposition of resulting material. This part of the condition shall not be
discharged until these elements have been fulfilled in accordance with the
programme set out in the WSI.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <o:p></o:p></p><p>











</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON: To help protect the special architectural or
historic interest of the listed building.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><b>Protect features<o:p></o:p></b></p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">Suitable precautions shall be taken to secure and protect
features (including, but not limited to, chimney pieces, plasterwork,
architraves, timber framing, panelling, doors, staircase balustrading) against
accidental loss or damage during the building work hereby granted, and no such
features may be disturbed or removed, temporarily or permanently, except as
indicated on the approved drawings or with the prior approval in writing of the
Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p>





</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic
interest of the listed building.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><b>Unknown evidence<o:p></o:p></b></p><p class="MsoNormal"><b>&nbsp;</b></p><p class="MsoNormal">During the works, if unknown evidence or hidden historic
features are revealed this shall be retained in-situ.&nbsp; Works shall be halted in the relevant area of
the building and the Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately.&nbsp; Failure to do so may result in unauthorised
works being carried out and an offence being committed.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:42.55pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:
-42.55pt">





</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON: To help protect the special architectural or
historic interest of the listed building.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><b>Precautionary Working Method Statement<o:p></o:p></b></p><p class="MsoNormal"><b>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <o:p></o:p></b></p><p class="MsoNormal">No further works shall take place until a Precautionary
Working Method Statement (PWMS) for bats has been submitted to and approved in
writing by the local planning authority. The PWMS should include, but may not
be limited to;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="i">
 <li class="MsoNormal">A toolbox talk covering
     the ecology of and legislation which protects species which may be present
     on site, to be delivered to construction personnel by the Ecological Clerk
     of Works (ECoW);<o:p></o:p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal">A plan showing areas of
     sensitivity and exclusion zones;<o:p></o:p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal">Details of which
     construction tasks pose a risk to protected species, and will therefore be
     supervised by the ECoW;<o:p></o:p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal">Guidance on sensitive roof
     strip techniques; and<o:p></o:p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal">Procedures to be followed
     if a protected species is discovered.<o:p></o:p></li>
</ol><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">The approved PWMS shall be implemented in full according to
the specified timescales, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local
planning authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:42.55pt;mso-add-space:auto;text-align:
justify;text-indent:-42.55pt">













</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON:&nbsp; To ensure the
protection of protected species during the construction phase of the
development, in accordance with Section 41 of the Natural Environmental and
Rural Communities Act 2006 (NERC), The Conservation of Habitats and Species
Regulations (2019), and The Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 (as amended)
(WCA).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><b>Roofing membrane<o:p></o:p></b></p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">No modern,
non-bitumen coated roofing membranes (NBCRMs) or spun-bond breathable roofing
membranes shall be installed in the roof of the building. Only traditional,
hessian-reinforced bituminous roofing felt (Type 1F to BS 747 specification)
shall be used in areas where bats may gain access to the roof structure. The
roofing underlay shall be installed in strict accordance with the approved
details, and checked by an Ecological Clerk of Works [EcoW] before roof tiles
are installed. The ECoW must provide photos of the installed roofing membrane
to the council following their inspection.<o:p></o:p></p><p>





</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON:&nbsp;&nbsp; To ensure the protection of bats which may
roost within the roof space of the dwelling, in accordance with Section 41 of
the Natural Environmental and Rural Communities Act 2006 (NERC), The
Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2019), and The Wildlife and
Countryside Act 1981 (as amended) (WCA).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><b>Timber replacement<o:p></o:p></b></p><p class="MsoNormal"><b>&nbsp;</b></p><p class="MsoNormal">Timber replacement in accordance with the method statement
in this submission shall only take place where it is confirmed to be beyond
repair by a suitable expert in written consultation with the Local Planning
Authority Conservation Officer. Details for the replacement works undertaken
are to be provided to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p>





</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON: To help protect the special architectural or
historic interest of the listed building.<o:p></o:p></p>
description: Listed Building Consent: Reconstruction of flank chimney stack and external walling together with removal of roof tiling and re-tiling following stabilisation works. Timber frame repairs and restoration to the south-west part of Chestnut Cottage including structural works, replacement and repair of some historic timberwork and some rebuilding of brick walls and foundations, lime render on laths externally and lime plaster on laths internally. Replacement flooring to ground floor dining room and hall. Underfloor heating and insulation works. (Some urgent repair works already undertaken to stabilise the existing structure).
